title: A first-intersection valley / odd-ascent / peak / even-descent taxonomy produces a new two-sided envelope
statement: Classifying the first shared point x of a forward trajectory from n with a hypothetical cycle by valley / odd interior / peak / even interior produces a first-intersection type, or a two-sided envelope at that type, that is not odd_preimage_unique / oddLanding_preimage_unique / cycleMin_starts_two_odds / cycleMin_not_odd_even / cycleMin_not_end_odd / exists_cycleMin_last_odd_run / cycle_peak_finance / extremal composition / trailing-EE count n(n^2+n+1), and that type empties or tightens a bound for a reason that is not an archived cell.
counterexamples: if n is on the cycle the first intersection is n; the 2+2 window is {OE|OO, EE|OO}
odd_preimage_unique / oddLanding_preimage_unique: at most one odd parent, so OO interior and a climb-created peak cannot be first intersections
peak two-sided scale F_climb(x) <= x <= D_cycle(x) is cycle_peak_finance / COMPOSITION_REPACKAGING
the only bulk distinct-parent channel is even+even, with count n(n^2+n+1)
notes: Phase 0 only. Not a reopen of the OE-corridor or cyclic-seam leftover-killers. The odd-odd collapse is a REPARAMETERIZATION of odd_preimage_unique. No finance, no K=11, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean, no census. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: paper collapse against existing Lean; unique odd parent on odd starts in [1,2001); uniqueness window [1,401) already in test_odd_landing_sets
